# SendChatMessage
|Inv mushroom 11 |**This function is restricted .**
`SAY` , `YELL` and `CHANNEL` require a hardware event while outdoors. |
| --- | --- |
Sends a chat message.
```
SendChatMessage(msg [, chatType, languageID, target])
```
